blocks.text: The INA228 is a high-precision digital power monitor featuring a 20-bit delta-sigma ADC for accurate measurement of current and bus voltage. It supports both high-side and low-side DC current sensing and can measure bus voltages up to 85 V.

The module communicates with a microcontroller through I²C and can report current, bus voltage, power, energy, charge, and internal temperature. The STEMMA QT / Qwiic connectors provide a convenient plug-and-play interface for compatible development boards.
Measures DC current, bus voltage, power, energy and charge
Supports high-side and low-side current measurement
Bus voltage measurement up to 85 V
Suitable for 3.3 V and 5 V logic systems
These are the specifications of the INA228 IC from Texas Instruments.
The INA228 measures the voltage across an external or onboard shunt resistor and calculates the corresponding current digitally.

For a module using the commonly supplied 15 mΩ shunt resistor, the module can be configured for different current ranges. For example, the Adafruit STEMMA QT/Qwiic implementation specifies up to approximately 10 A in its high-current configuration or 2.75 A in its higher-resolution configuration.

Important: The maximum safe current of a particular module depends on its shunt resistor, PCB copper, connector, thermal conditions, and operating environment. Do not treat the 85 V rating as an 85 V/10 A continuous power rating.
The module uses I²C for communication with the host microcontroller.
The STEMMA QT / Qwiic connectors provide a convenient 4-wire connection for VCC, GND, SDA and SCL.
The INA228 is designed for DC measurement; it should not be connected directly to AC mains or used as an AC current monitor.
The 85 V specification refers to the supported bus/common-mode voltage, not the maximum voltage that can be applied arbitrarily to every module connection.
The actual maximum measurable current depends on the module’s shunt resistor and thermal design.
The module requires an appropriate shunt resistor for current measurement.
The INA228 itself operates from 2.7–5.5 V, while the monitored bus can be substantially higher, up to 85 V within the device’s specified conditions.

blocks.text: TPL5110DDCR Nano-Power System Timer for Power Gating SOT23-6
The TPL5110DDCR is a nano-power system timer from Texas Instruments, ideal for ultra-low-power applications like power gating in battery-powered or duty-cycled systems. Here are its core specs:
Supply Voltage: Operates from 1.8 V to 5.5 V
Typical Operating Current: 35 nA at 2.5 V
Selectable Time Intervals: From 100 ms up to 7200 s (2 hours)
Selection Method: By adjusting resistor values (resistor-selectable interval)
Manual Power-On: Supports manual MOSFET power-on and has a one-shot mode (timer fires once then stops)
Includes a MOSFET driver to gate power (acts as a power switch)
Intended Use Cases: Designed for battery-powered systems, IoT nodes, intruder or tamper detection, home automation sensors, thermostats, remote sensors, and more
The TPL5110DDCR acts like an ultra-efficient timer-based switch:
You set it to wake up your main system (like a microcontroller) at intervals ranging from a fraction of a second to two hours.
When the timer fires, the built-in MOSFET driver activates power (turns on) to your system.
Optionally, you can use “one-shot” mode to briefly power up only once.
After the job is done (e.g., taking a measurement or transmitting data), your system can signal the TPL5110 to turn itself off again, consuming virtually no standby power (just 35 nA!).

The μPFC IR1155 power factor correction IC, based on IR proprietary “One Cycle Control” (OCC) technique, provides for high PF, low THD and excellent DC Bus regulation while enabling drastic reduction in component

count, PCB area and design time as compared to traditional solutions. The IC is designed to operate in continuous conduction mode Boost PFC converters with average current mode control over 85-264VAC input line voltage range. Switching frequency can be programmed to anywhere between 48kHz to 200kHz based on the specific application requirement. In addition, IR1155 offers several advanced system-enabling and protective

features such as dedicated pin for over voltage protection, cycle by cycle peak current limitation, open loop protection, VCC UVLO, soft-start and micropower startup/sleep-mode with IC current consumption less than
200µA. The sleep mode, invoked by pulling the OVP/EN pin low, enables compliance with standby power requirements mandated by regulations such as Energy Star, Green Power, Blue Angel etc.

TPS23753A is a combined Power over Ethernet (PoE) powered device (PD) interface and current-mode DC-DC controller optimized specifically for isolated converter designs. The PoE implementation supports the IEEE 802.3at standard as a 13-W, type 1 PD. The requirements for an IEEE 802.3at type 1 device are a superset of IEEE 802.3-2008 (originally IEEE 802.3af). The TPS23753A supports a number of input-voltage ORing options including highest voltage, external adapter preference, and PoE preference. The PoE interface features an external detection signature pin that can also be used to disable the internal hotswap MOSFET. This allows the PoE function to be turned off. Classification can be programmed to any of the defined types with a single resistor. The DC-DC controller features a bootstrap start-up mechanism with an internal, switched current source. This provides the advantages of cycling overload fault protection without the constant power loss of a pullup resistor. The programmable oscillator may be synchronized to a higher-frequency external timing reference. The TPS23753A features improvements for uninterrupted device operation through an ESD event.

1206 self-recovery fuse is composed of specially treated polymer resin (Polymer) and conductive particles (Carbon Black) distributed inside.

Under normal operation, the polymer resin tightly binds the conductive particles outside the crystalline structure to form a chain-like conductive electrical path. At this time, the recoverable fuse is in a low resistance state (a), which is generated by the current flowing through the resettable fuse on the line The heat energy is small and will not change the crystal structure. When the circuit is short-circuited or overloaded, the heat generated by the large current flowing through the recoverable fuse melts the polymer resin, and the volume increases rapidly to form a high-resistance state (b), and the operating current decreases rapidly, thereby limiting and protecting the circuit.

When the fault is removed, the PTC can recover the fuse to re-cool and crystallize, the volume shrinks, the conductive particles re-form a conductive path, and the self-recoverable fuse returns to a low resistance state, thus completing the protection of the circuit without manual replacement.

The TP8485E are IEC61000 ESD protected, 3V~5.5V powered transceivers that meet the RS-485 and RS-422 standards for balanced communication. Driver outputs and receiver inputs are protected against ±18kV ESD strikes without latch-up. Transmitters in this family deliver exceptional differential output voltages (2.5V min/5Vcc), into the RS-485 required 54Ω load, for better noise immunity, or to allow up to eight 120Ω terminations in “star” topologies. These devices have very low bus currents so they present a true “1/8 unit load” to the RS-485 bus. This allows up to 256 transceivers on the network without using repeaters. Receiver (Rx) inputs feature a “Full Fail-Safe” design, which ensures a logic high Rx output if Rx inputs are floating, shorted, or on a terminated but undriven bus. Rx outputs feature high drive levels – typically 25mA @ VOL = 1V (to ease the design of optocoupled isolated interfaces). The TP8485E is available in an SOIC-8 and MSOP-8 package, and is characterized from –40°C to 125°C.

This examples demonstrates a way to know the approximate concentration of Gas. As per the data-sheet of the MQ5 sensors, these equations are tested for standard conditions and are not calibrated. It may vary based on change in temperature or humidity.
Keep the Gas Sensor in clean air environment. Upload the program below.

void setup() { Serial.begin(9600); } void loop() { float sensor_volt; float RS_air; // Get the value of RS via in a clear air float R0; // Get the value of R0 via in H2 float sensorValue; /*--- Get a average data by testing 100 times ---*/ for(int x = 0 ; x < 100 ; x++) { sensorValue = sensorValue + analogRead(A0); } sensorValue = sensorValue/100.0; /*-----------------------------------------------*/ sensor_volt = sensorValue/1024*5.0; RS_air = (5.0-sensor_volt)/sensor_volt; // omit *RL R0 = RS_air/6.5; // The ratio of RS/R0 is 6.5 in a clear air from Graph (Found using WebPlotDigitizer) Serial.print("sensor_volt = "); Serial.print(sensor_volt); Serial.println("V"); Serial.print("R0 = "); Serial.println(R0); delay(1000); }
Then, open the serial monitor of Arduino IDE. Write down the value of R0 and this needs to be used in the next program. Please node down the R0 after the reading stabilizes.
Replace the R0 below with value of R0 tested above . Expose the sensor to any one of the gas listed above.

void setup() { Serial.begin(9600); } void loop() { float sensor_volt; float RS_gas; // Get value of RS in a GAS float ratio; // Get ratio RS_GAS/RS_air int sensorValue = analogRead(A0); sensor_volt=(float)sensorValue/1024*5.0; RS_gas = (5.0-sensor_volt)/sensor_volt; // omit *RL /*-Replace the name "R0" with the value of R0 in the demo of First Test -*/ ratio = RS_gas/R0; // ratio = RS/R0 /*-----------------------------------------------------------------------*/ Serial.print("sensor_volt = "); Serial.println(sensor_volt); Serial.print("RS_ratio = "); Serial.println(RS_gas); Serial.print("Rs/R0 = "); Serial.println(ratio); Serial.print(" "); delay(1000); }

The L297 is a stepper motor controller IC designed to drive bipolar and unipolar stepper motors in various applications. It generates the necessary phase drive signals to control the movement of the motor, reducing the burden on a microprocessor. The L297 is capable of operating in multiple drive modes, including half step, full step, and wave drive, offering flexibility for different motor configurations. The integrated PWM chopper circuit efficiently regulates the current in the motor windings, minimizing energy losses during operation.

This IC simplifies stepper motor control by generating the required four-phase sequences internally. It only requires input signals for clock, direction, and mode, making it an ideal choice for microcomputer-controlled applications. The L297 can be used in conjunction with bridge drivers like the L298N or L293E, or in custom configurations using discrete transistors.

The L297 IC is housed in both DIP20 and SO20 packages, making it suitable for various applications. Its ability to synchronize multiple devices and efficiently handle load current makes it a valuable component in stepper motor control systems, particularly where precision and energy efficiency are paramount.

أسلاك قياس للأفوميتر بسن رفيع طول ١٠٠ سم

أسلاك قياس للأفوميتر بسن رفيع طول ١٠٠ سم هي طقم مجسات قياس عملي مكون من سلك أحمر وسلك أسود، مناسب للاستخدام مع أجهزة القياس المتوافقة في أعمال الصيانة الإلكترونية، الاختبارات، التجارب، وقياس الجهد والمقاومة والاستمرارية. يتميز الطقم بسن معدني رفيع يساعد على الوصول إلى نقاط القياس الصغيرة داخل الدوائر الإلكترونية واللوحات التجريبية والأماكن الضيقة.

هذا الطقم مناسب لفنيين الصيانة، طلاب الإلكترونيات، الهواة، ومراكز الإصلاح التي تحتاج إلى مجسات قياس دقيقة بدل المجسات السميكة التقليدية. السن الرفيع يساعد على لمس أرجل المكونات الصغيرة، نقاط الاختبار، أطراف التوصيل، وفتحات اللوحات التجريبية بسهولة أكبر وبدقة أعلى، خصوصًا عند العمل على لوحات مزدحمة أو مكونات قريبة من بعضها.

يأتي الطقم بلونين واضحين: الأحمر للموجب والأسود للسالب، مما يسهل تمييز القطبية أثناء القياس. كما أن المقابض مصممة بملمس مانع للانزلاق لتوفير تحكم أفضل أثناء الاستخدام، مع شكل مريح مناسب للاستخدام المتكرر في الورشة أو المعمل.

توضح الصور أن الطقم يحتوي على مجسين بسن معدني حاد ورفيع، مع أسلاك مرنة ومقابس زاوية مناسبة لكثير من أجهزة القياس. يظهر في الصور أن طول السلك التقريبي حوالي ٩٠ سم، مع طول جسم المجس حوالي ١٣٣ مم، وطول السن المكشوف حوالي ١٥٫٨ مم. وبناءً على البيانات المرسلة يتم إدراج المنتج كطقم أسلاك قياس بطول إجمالي يقارب ١٠٠ سم.

blocks.v: Bidirectional Data Bus · Input/Output · This 3-state 8-bit bidirectional data bus is used in reading status registers and writing command words through the RD/WR signal from the CPU, and also in reading the CALL instruction code by the INTA signal from the CPU.

Chip Select Input · Input · Data transfer with the CPU is enabled by RD/WR when this pin is at low level. The data bus (D0 through D7) is switched to high impedance when this pin is at high level. Note that CS does not affect INTA.

Read Input · Input · Data is transferred from the MSM82C59A-2 to the CPU when this pin is at low level. IRR (Interrupt Request Register), ISR (In-Service Register), IMR (Interrupt Mask Register), or a Poll word is selected by OCW3 and A0.
Write Input · Input · Commands are transferred from the CPU to the MSM82C59A-2 when this pin is at low level.

Address Input · Input · This pin is used together with the CS, WR, and RD signals to write commands in the command registers, and to select and read status registers. This is normally connected to the least significant bit of the address bus (A0 for MSM80C85A, A1 for MSM80C86A-10/88A-10).
Cascade Address · Input/Output · These pins are outputs when the MSM82C59A-2 is used as the master, and inputs when used as a slave (in cascade mode). These pins are outputs when in single mode.

Slave Program Input / Enable Buffer Output · Input/Output · This dual-function pin is used as an output to enable the data bus buffer in Buffered mode, and as an input for deciding whether the MSM82C59A-2 is to be master (SP/EN = 1) or slave (SP/EN = 0) during Non-buffered mode.
Interrupt Output · Output · When an interrupt request is made to the MSM82C59A-2, the INT output is switched to high level, and an INT interrupt is sent to the CPU.

Interrupt Acknowledge Input · Input · When this pin is at low level, the CALL instruction code or the interrupt vector data is enabled onto the data bus. When the CPU acknowledges the INT interrupt, INTA is sent to the MSM82C59A-2.

Request Input · Input · These interrupt request input pins for the MSM82C59A-2 can be set to edge trigger mode or level trigger mode (by ICW1). In edge trigger mode, interrupt requests are executed by the rising edge of the IR input and held until acknowledged by the CPU. In level trigger mode, interrupt requests are executed by high-level IR inputs and held until acknowledged by the CPU. These pins have a pull-up resistor.

blocks.text: The RS-CO-I20-2-2000P-2 is a fixed carbon monoxide gas sensor engineered for continuous ambient CO monitoring in industrial, commercial, or building automation systems. It is housed in a durable, sealed enclosure to defend the internal sensing element from dust, moisture, and mechanical stress. It is intended for semi-permanent installation in locations where CO accumulation is a safety concern, such as boiler rooms, garages, tunnels, or near combustion equipment.

Carbon monoxide gas enters the sensor chamber via diffusion through a membrane or vent port and reaches the internal electrochemical sensing element. The CO molecules react at the electrode surface to induce a proportional electrical signal change. Onboard signal conditioning circuitry then linearizes and scales that signal to a 4-20 mA analog current output. Compensation circuits correct for ambient temperature and humidity influences to enhance measurement consistency.

Over extended operation, the RS-CO-I20-2-2000P-2 is designed to maintain stability via low drift electronics and calibration correction mechanisms. Its 4-20 mA output is directly compatible with PLCs, data acquisition systems, or alarm controllers. When CO levels exceed defined thresholds, the sensor’s signal can trigger ventilation systems, alerts, or safety interlocks. blocks.text: The TEC1-12709 Thermoelectric Cooler 9A Peltier Module is the simple application of the Peltier Thermoelectric Effect. The module features 127 semiconductor couples in the area of 40mmx40mm which very effectively cools and heats up to 80°C.

Thermoelectric coolers also are known as TEC or Peltier Module create a temperature differential on each side. One side gets hot and the other side gets cool. Therefore, they can be used to either warm something up or cool something down, depending on which side you use. You can also take advantage of a temperature differential to generate electricity.

This Peltier works very well as long as you remove the heat from the hot side. After turning on the device, the hot side will heat quickly, the cold side will cool quickly. If you do not remove the heat from the hot side (with a heat sink or other device), the Peltier will quickly reach stasis and do nothing. We recommend using an old computer CPU heatsink or another block of metal to pull heat from the hot side. We were able to use a computer power supply and CPU heatsink to make the cold side so uncomfortable we could not hold our finger to it.

A thermoelectric cooling (TEC) module is a semiconductor-based electronic component that functions as a small heat pump. By applying the DC power source to a TEC, heat will be transferred from one side of the module to the other. It creates a cold and hot side. They are widely used in industrial areas, for example, computer CPU, CCDs, portable refrigerators, medical instruments, and so on.

طول الكابل حوالي ٥٥ سم، وهو طول عملي للتوصيلات القصيرة داخل الأجهزة أو بين البطارية ووحدة التحكم أو بين مزود الطاقة والحمل. جسم الفيشة موضح عليه طرف موجب وطرف سالب لتقليل أخطاء التوصيل أثناء التركيب، كما أن القاعدة المعدنية تساعد على تثبيت الفيشة بشكل أفضل داخل اللوحات أو العلب.

blocks.text: WS2811 Addressable RGB LED Module DC 12V – 3LED Waterproof Pixel Light

The WS2811 Addressable RGB LED Module DC 12V is a professional pixel lighting module designed for applications that require colorful, programmable, and dynamic lighting effects. Unlike standard single-color LED modules, this module is addressable, which means each module can be controlled through a compatible controller to display different colors, animations, chasing effects, flowing patterns, flashing sequences, and custom lighting scenes.

Each module contains 3 RGB LEDs and uses the WS2811 addressable control IC, making it suitable for RGB signage, decorative lighting, advertising displays, shop lighting, event decoration, and creative electronics projects. It operates on DC 12V, which makes it easier to use in longer installations compared with many 5V addressable LED products, especially when voltage drop needs to be reduced.

The module body is designed for outdoor and indoor use, with a waterproof construction suitable for sign makers, lighting installers, advertising workshops, and custom decoration projects. The compact module size allows it to be installed behind acrylic letters, inside light boxes, along decorative surfaces, or inside custom lighting panels.
This product is sold as one single piece, making it suitable for repair, replacement, testing, or building a custom number of LED pixels according to your project needs.

موديول الإضاءة الملون القابل للتحكم موديل دبليو إس 2811 هو حل عملي ومميز لمشروعات الإضاءة التي تحتاج إلى ألوان متغيرة وتأثيرات حركية، وليس مجرد إضاءة ثابتة بلون واحد. يمكن استخدامه في اللافتات الإعلانية، علب الإضاءة، حروف الأكريليك، الديكورات الداخلية، الديكورات الخارجية، واجهات المحلات، إضاءة المناسبات، ومشروعات الهواة والمحترفين.

يتميز هذا الموديول بأنه قابل للتحكم، أي أنه يعمل مع متحكم مناسب لإظهار ألوان مختلفة وحركات إضاءة مثل التتابع، الوميض، تغير الألوان، الحركة المتدرجة، وتأثيرات الإضاءة المخصصة. لذلك فهو مناسب جدًا عند الحاجة إلى إضاءة ملفتة للنظر في الإعلانات أو العروض أو الديكور.

يعمل المنتج على جهد 12 فولت تيار مستمر، مما يجعله مناسبًا للاستخدام مع مزودات الطاقة الشائعة في أنظمة الإضاءة واللافتات. كما أن استخدام جهد 12 فولت يساعد في بعض التركيبات الطويلة مقارنة ببعض الأنظمة الأقل في الجهد، بشرط استخدام مزود طاقة مناسب وتوصيل صحيح.

يحتوي كل موديول على ثلاث نقاط إضاءة ملونة داخل جسم صغير الحجم، مع تصميم مقاوم للماء ومناسب للتركيب في الأماكن الداخلية والخارجية. كما يوجد خلف الموديول شريط لاصق يساعد على تثبيته بسرعة على الأسطح المناسبة.

blocks.text: RELIFE RL-444 Nickel Sheet Solder Wire 0.8mm

RELIFE RL-444 Nickel Sheet Solder Wire 0.8mm is a specialized solder wire designed for battery nickel sheet soldering and metal repair applications where ordinary solder wire may not provide the required activity. It is especially useful for mobile phone battery nickel tabs, battery connection sheets, stainless steel, nickel, zinc, iron, copper, aluminum, and other difficult metal surfaces that require stronger soldering activity and better wetting.

This solder wire is designed for welder-free operation, allowing technicians to solder battery nickel sheets using a suitable soldering iron instead of relying only on spot welding equipment. It is a practical option for repair benches, battery maintenance, mobile phone battery work, electronics repair, and metal contact soldering where controlled manual soldering is needed.

The 0.8mm wire diameter offers a strong and practical solder feed for battery tab work and metal sheet soldering. Compared with very thin solder wire, the thicker 0.8mm size provides more solder volume per feed, making it suitable for larger contact surfaces, battery terminals, nickel strip edges, and metal connection points that need a firm solder joint.

RELIFE RL-444 is made with high tin content material and a smooth wire surface to support stable soldering performance. Its good activity helps remove oxide film more effectively during soldering, improving solder spread and helping create bright, firm solder joints. This makes it suitable for repair tasks where strong bonding, good conductivity, and clean soldering results are important.

سلك قصدير ريلايف للحام شرائح النيكل قطر ٠.٨ مللي

سلك قصدير ريلايف للحام شرائح النيكل قطر ٠.٨ مللي هو سلك لحام متخصص مصمم لأعمال لحام شرائح توصيل البطاريات والأسطح المعدنية التي يصعب لحامها بالقصدير العادي. يناسب هذا السلك أعمال صيانة بطاريات الهواتف، شرائح النيكل، نقاط التوصيل المعدنية، وبعض الأسطح مثل الستانلس والنيكل والزنك والحديد والنحاس والألومنيوم حسب طبيعة السطح وطريقة التحضير.

تم تصميم هذا المنتج ليساعد الفني على تنفيذ لحام يدوي بدون الحاجة لاستخدام جهاز لحام نقطي في بعض أعمال الإصلاح المناسبة. لذلك يعتبر حلًا عمليًا على ترابيزة الصيانة عند التعامل مع شرائح البطاريات ونقاط التوصيل المعدنية التي تحتاج إلى قصدير أكثر نشاطًا وقدرة أفضل على الانتشار فوق المعدن.

قطر السلك ٠.٨ مللي يعطي تغذية أقوى من الأسلاك الرفيعة، لذلك يكون مناسبًا للأماكن التي تحتاج إلى كمية قصدير أكبر مثل أطراف شرائح النيكل، أطراف البطاريات، نقاط التوصيل المعدنية، وبعض الإصلاحات التي تحتاج إلى نقطة لحام ثابتة وقوية. كما يساعد السطح الناعم للسلك على سهولة الاستخدام والتحكم أثناء اللحام.

يتميز سلك ريلايف هذا بمحتوى قصدير عالٍ ونشاط جيد يساعد على إزالة طبقة الأكسدة وتحسين انتشار القصدير على السطح، مما يساعد على تكوين نقاط لحام لامعة ومتماسكة عند الاستخدام الصحيح. وهو مناسب للفنيين ومراكز الصيانة وورش إصلاح البطاريات والإلكترونيات التي تحتاج إلى أداء أكثر قوة من القصدير التقليدي.

blocks.text: 12C-P10 12mm Metal Momentary Push Button Switch 2-Pin Without LED

The 12C-P10 12mm Metal Momentary Push Button Switch is a compact and durable push button designed for panel-mount control applications where a simple temporary switching function is required. It is suitable for electronic projects, control panels, dashboards, testing equipment, relay trigger circuits, reset buttons, machine control inputs, and low-current signal circuits.

This model is a Momentary Normally Open switch. In the normal state, the switch contact is open and the circuit remains OFF. When the button is pressed, the internal contact closes and the circuit turns ON. Once the button is released, the internal spring returns the button automatically to its original position and the circuit turns OFF again.

Unlike LED illuminated push buttons, this 12C-P10 version is a non-illuminated 2-pin switch. It does not include any LED ring or indicator light, so wiring is simpler and more direct. The two terminals are used only for the switch contact, making it a practical choice when visual indication is not required or when the panel already has a separate indicator lamp.

The 12mm threaded body allows easy installation into metal panels, plastic enclosures, acrylic sheets, electrical boxes, and custom DIY project cases. The metal front body gives the switch a clean and professional appearance while offering better durability than standard plastic push buttons.

Because this switch is momentary and normally open, it is ideal for temporary commands such as reset, test, trigger, enable, start signal, manual input, or relay activation. It is not designed to stay ON after pressing. If the circuit needs to remain ON after a single press, a self-locking or latching push button should be selected instead.

The typical rating for similar 12mm metal momentary normally open 2-pin switches is commonly listed up to 3A 250VAC, but actual rating may vary by manufacturing batch. For safety, use this switch mainly in control and signal circuits, or use it to trigger a relay, contactor, transistor driver, or electronic control module when working with higher loads.

مفتاح ضغط معدني لحظي بدون إضاءة مقاس 12 مللي طرفين

مفتاح الضغط المعدني اللحظي بدون إضاءة مقاس 12 مللي هو مفتاح صغير وعملي مخصص للتركيب على لوحات التحكم والعلب الإلكترونية ولوحات التشغيل. يتميز المفتاح بواجهة معدنية أنيقة، وتصميم بسيط بدون إضاءة، وطرفين فقط للتوصيل، مما يجعله مناسبًا للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى زر تحكم لحظي مباشر بدون مؤشر ضوئي.

هذا المفتاح يعمل بنظام التشغيل اللحظي المفتوح في الوضع الطبيعي. في الحالة العادية تكون الدائرة مفصولة، وعند الضغط على الزر يتم توصيل الدائرة، وعند ترك الزر يعود المفتاح تلقائيًا إلى وضع الفصل. لذلك فهو مناسب جدًا للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى أمر مؤقت فقط، مثل إعادة تشغيل دائرة، تشغيل ريلاي، إعطاء إشارة تحكم، تنفيذ أمر اختبار، أو تفعيل مدخل تحكم داخل لوحة إلكترونية.

يختلف هذا المنتج عن النسخ المضيئة لأنه لا يحتوي على حلقة إضاءة ولا يحتاج إلى أطراف خاصة للإضاءة. لذلك فهو يأتي بطرفين فقط، والطرفان مخصصان لدائرة المفتاح نفسها. هذا يجعل توصيله أبسط وأسهل، خصوصًا في اللوحات التي لا تحتاج إلى إضاءة داخل الزر أو التي تحتوي بالفعل على لمبة بيان منفصلة.

يتم تركيب المفتاح في فتحة مقاس 12 مللي، ويثبت باستخدام الصامولة وحلقة التثبيت. يمكن تركيبه في الألواح المعدنية أو البلاستيكية أو الأكريليك أو علب المشاريع الإلكترونية. كما أن الواجهة المعدنية تمنحه مظهرًا احترافيًا ومتانة أعلى من المفاتيح البلاستيكية التقليدية.

يفضل استخدام هذا المفتاح في دوائر التحكم والإشارة منخفضة التيار. وبالنسبة لتحمل الفولت والتيار، فالنسخ المشابهة من مفاتيح الضغط المعدنية مقاس 12 مللي بطرفين تكون غالبًا بتصنيف يصل إلى 3 أمبير عند 250 فولت تيار متردد حسب الدفعة، لكن الأفضل استخدامه كزر تحكم أو إشارة، خصوصًا مع الأحمال العالية. عند تشغيل محركات أو سخانات أو أحمال تسحب تيارًا عاليًا، يفضل استخدام المفتاح لتشغيل ريلاي أو دائرة قيادة مناسبة بدلًا من تمرير الحمل مباشرة من خلاله.

blocks.text: HW-508 Active Buzzer Module 3-Pin Alarm Sound Module

The HW-508 Active Buzzer Module is a small and practical sound module used to generate simple alert tones in electronic circuits and embedded projects. This module is based on an active buzzer, which means it contains an internal oscillation circuit that allows it to produce sound directly once the proper voltage is applied.

Unlike passive buzzers that need a changing square-wave signal from a microcontroller to create tones, the active buzzer is much easier to use. In most applications, it can generate a beep or alarm sound simply by powering the module or driving its signal pin. This makes it an excellent choice for designers who need a straightforward sound indicator without additional audio signal generation.

Because of its compact size and easy interface, the HW-508 Active Buzzer Module is widely used in alarm systems, warning indicators, smart devices, security systems, educational electronics, and microcontroller-based projects. It is especially useful in applications where the goal is to produce a quick and reliable audible alert rather than programmable musical tones.

The module is well suited for Arduino and similar development boards, and it can be used in prototypes as well as finished products. Whether you need a simple notification sound, a status indicator, or an alarm output, this module offers a convenient and reliable solution.

وحدة جرس نشط اتش دبليو 508 ثلاثية الأطراف للتنبيه الصوتي

تُعد وحدة الجرس النشط اتش دبليو 508 من الوحدات العملية والبسيطة المستخدمة لإضافة صوت تنبيه سريع وواضح داخل الدوائر الإلكترونية والمشاريع المختلفة. تعتمد هذه الوحدة على جرس نشط يحتوي على دائرة توليد داخلية، وهذا يعني أنه يستطيع إصدار الصوت مباشرة عند توصيله وتشغيله بشكل صحيح.

ويمثل ذلك فرقًا مهمًا مقارنة بالجرس السلبي، لأن الجرس السلبي يحتاج إلى إشارة متغيرة أو موجة مربعة من المتحكم الدقيق حتى يصدر صوتًا، بينما الجرس النشط أسهل في الاستخدام لأنه مناسب للتطبيقات التي تحتاج فقط إلى صفارة أو تنبيه صوتي مباشر بدون الحاجة إلى توليد نغمات برمجيًا.

بفضل حجمه الصغير وسهولة توصيله، يمكن استخدام هذه الوحدة في كثير من المشاريع مثل أنظمة الإنذار، والتنبيه، وأجهزة الحماية، والأجهزة الذكية، والمشاريع التعليمية، ولوحات التطوير المعتمدة على المتحكمات الدقيقة. كما أنها مناسبة جدًا عندما يكون المطلوب هو إعطاء إشارة صوتية واضحة عند حدوث حالة معينة مثل وجود خطأ، أو انتهاء مؤقت، أو وصول إشارة، أو تفعيل وظيفة داخل النظام.
تتميز هذه الوحدة بأنها سهلة الدمج داخل النماذج الأولية والمشاريع النهائية، وتُعد خيارًا مناسبًا للطلاب والهواة والمهندسين الذين يريدون إضافة تنبيه صوتي بسيط وفعال دون تعقيد في التوصيل أو البرمجة.

يعتمد هذا الموصل على آلية تثبيت زنبركية تساعد على توصيل الأسلاك بسرعة وسهولة مقارنة بطرق الربط التقليدية التي تعتمد على المسامير. هذا التصميم يقلل وقت التركيب، ويسهّل أعمال الصيانة، ويساعد على توفير تثبيت جيد للسلك واتصال كهربائي ثابت مع مرور الوقت. كما أنه لا يحتاج إلى لف الأسلاك أو لحامها، مما يجعله خيارًا مريحًا في التوصيلات العملية اليومية.

ومن أهم ما يميز هذا المنتج أنه مخصص للتثبيت على اللوحات، لذلك فهو مناسب جدًا للاستخدام داخل لوحات التحكم، وصناديق التوزيع، وأنظمة الإضاءة، والأنظمة الصناعية الخفيفة، وتجهيزات الأتمتة، والتوصيلات الداخلية في الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية. كما يساعد هذا الأسلوب في التركيب على تحسين شكل التوصيلات وثباتها داخل النظام.

تم تصنيع جسم الموصل من بولي كربونات مقاوم للاشتعال، وهو ما يدعم مستوى جيدًا من الأمان والمتانة أثناء الاستخدام. أما الجزء الموصل الداخلي فهو مصنوع من سبيكة نحاسية مطلية بالقصدير للمساعدة في تحقيق توصيل كهربائي جيد وثابت. كما أن الموصل قابل لإعادة الاستخدام، مما يجعله مناسبًا في الحالات التي تتطلب إعادة التوصيل أو التعديل لاحقًا.

وبفضل حجمه العملي وأبعاده الصغيرة نسبيًا، يمكن استخدام هذا الموصل في التطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى توصيل سريع وآمن ومنظم داخل مساحات محدودة. لذلك فهو مناسب للفنيين، والكهربائيين، ومركبي اللوحات، وأعمال الصيانة، وكذلك للمشاريع التي تتطلب جودة توصيل أعلى وشكلًا أكثر احترافية.

blocks.text: JCS7N60F 600V 7A N-Channel Power MOSFET – High-Voltage Switching, TO-220MF

The JCS7N60F is a high-voltage N-channel power MOSFET designed for robust switching in power conversion and high-energy control circuits. Rated at 600V (VDS) with up to 7A continuous drain current (ID), it is a dependable choice for high-voltage switching stages where electrical stability, thermal endurance, and consistent performance are required.

This device delivers a practical balance between switching behavior and conduction efficiency. With RDS(on) up to 1.2Ω, it helps manage conduction losses in many real-world designs, while its total gate charge (Qg = 54nC) supports stable gate-drive requirements commonly found in SMPS and inverter topologies. The MOSFET also offers predictable dynamic performance with 80ns rise time and 115pF output capacitance (Coss), which can help reduce switching stress when paired with a suitable driver and layout.

Housed in a TO-220MF package, the JCS7N60F is convenient for installation and heatsink mounting, making it suitable for power supplies, converters, inverters, and industrial switching stages operating under varying load and temperature conditions.
Rugged design: suitable for high-voltage power stages
Package: TO-220MF for easy mounting and cooling

يقدم هذا الموسفت توازنًا عمليًا بين كفاءة التوصيل وسلوك التبديل. تساعد قيمة مقاومة التشغيل RDS(on) حتى 1.2 أوم على تقليل فاقد التوصيل في كثير من التطبيقات الواقعية، بينما تتيح شحنة بوابة كلية Qg = 54 نانو كولوم متطلبات قيادة بوابة مستقرة في تصميمات مزودات الطاقة SMPS والإنفرترات. كما يتمتع بأداء ديناميكي متوقع مع زمن صعود 80 نانو ثانية وسعة خرج 115 بيكو فاراد (Coss)، وهو ما يساعد على تقليل إجهاد التبديل عند استخدام درايفر مناسب وتصميم PCB جيد.
يأتي JCS7N60F في باكيدج TO-220MF لتسهيل التركيب وإمكانية التثبيت على مشتت حراري، ما يجعله مناسبًا لمزودات الطاقة والمحولات والإنفرترات وتطبيقات التبديل الصناعية ذات الجهد العالي.

blocks.text: USB TO UART TTL FTDI 5V 3.3V FT232RL Download Cable To Serial Adapter Module For Arduino

The USB TO UART TTL 5V 3.3V FT232RL Download Cable To Serial Adapter Module is a basic breakout board for the FTDI FT232RL USB to serial IC, Revision 2. The pinout of this board matches the FTDI cable to work with official Arduino and cloned 5V Arduino boards. It can also be used for general serial applications.

The major difference with this board is that it brings out the DTR pin as opposed to the RTS pin of the FTDI cable. The DTR pin allows an Arduino target to auto-reset when a new Sketch is downloaded. This is a really nice feature to have and allows a sketch to be downloaded without having to hit the reset button. This board will auto reset any Arduino board that has the reset pin brought out to a 6-pin connector.

The pins labelled BLK and GRN correspond to the coloured wires on the FTDI cable. The black wire on the FTDI cable is GND, green is CTS. Use these BLK and GRN pins to align the FTDI basic board with your Arduino target.
This board has TX and RX LEDs that make it a bit better to use over the FTDI cable. You can actually see serial traffic on the LEDs to verify if the board is working.
This board was designed to decrease the cost of Arduino development and increase ease of use (the auto-reset feature rocks!). Our Arduino Pro boards and LilyPads use this type of connector.

One of the nice features of this board is a jumper on the back of the board that allows the board to be configured to either 3.3V or 5V (both power output and IO level). This board ship default to 5V, but you can cut the default trace and add a solder jumper if you need to switch to 3.3V.

blocks.text: A 12V 40W heater is a type of electric heater designed to operate at 12 volts DC and consume 40 watts of power. These heaters are commonly used in various applications, including in automotive, DIY projects, small portable heating devices, and even in some hobby electronics for temperature regulation or warming purposes.
Key Specifications and Features of a 12V 40W Heater
This is the voltage required to operate the heater. It is commonly used in systems powered by car batteries, solar panels, or DC power supplies.
The heater consumes 40 watts of power when in operation. This will determine how much current it draws from the 12V source.

To calculate the current draw of a 12V 40W heater, we use Ohm’s law: I=PV=40W12V=3.33AI = frac{P}{V} = frac{40W}{12V} = 3.33AI=VP​=12V40W​=3.33A So, the heater will draw approximately 3.33 amps of current at full power.
The heater typically consists of a resistive heating element (often made of metal wire, like nichrome), which heats up when electrical current passes through it.
Automotive: 12V heaters are commonly used in cars, trucks, or RVs for defrosting windows or as personal cabin heaters.
DIY Projects: 12V heaters can be used in custom heating solutions, such as incubators, soldering stations, or small space heaters.
Portable Devices: Small portable heating devices for camping, boating, or in applications where a 12V power supply is used, such as in some recreational vehicles (RVs).
Aquarium Heaters: In small fish tanks or reptile enclosures, where low-voltage heaters are needed.
12V 40W heaters can be relatively compact and efficient for small heating tasks. However, they will not be suitable for large-scale heating applications as they are low-power devices.
The physical design varies, but they are typically either a ceramic-based heating element, a metal coil surrounded by insulation, or carbon fiber heaters.
Overcurrent Protection: Given the current draw of 3.33A, it’s important to ensure that the power supply or wiring can handle this without overheating.
Temperature Control: It’s recommended to include a temperature sensor or thermostat in the circuit to avoid overheating, especially if the heater is used in an enclosed space.
Since the heater operates at 12V DC, it will need a power source that can supply at least 3.33 amps at 12V. Common options include:
12V DC power supplies: These are typically used for stationary applications, like powering the heater from a wall outlet (AC to DC).
12V battery: Used in mobile or off-grid applications, such as with solar panels, or in vehicles like cars, RVs, or boats.
Make sure to connect the positive terminal of your 12V power supply to the positive terminal of the heater and the negative terminal to the negative terminal.
Use wires capable of handling the 3.33A current without excessive heating. For example, 18 AWG wire should be suitable for most cases.
Once connected, when you apply power to the heater, the resistive element will begin to heat up, converting the electrical energy into heat.
To control the temperature of the heater, you can add a thermostat or PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) control, which can modulate the heater’s power and prevent overheating.
Since the heater will generate heat, ensure the surrounding area has adequate ventilation to prevent heat buildup, which could lead to component failure or fire hazards.
12V Power Supply (capable of delivering at least 3.33A)
Thermostat or Temperature Sensor (optional, for automatic control)
Connect the positive terminal of the 12V power supply to the positive terminal of the heater.
Connect the negative terminal of the heater to the negative terminal of the power supply.
Optionally, wire a thermostat or temperature sensor in series with the heater to control the on/off state of the heater based on the temperature.
Place a 4A fuse in series with the positive power line to protect the heater from potential overcurrent situations.

Heating Rate: The heater will provide 40 watts of thermal energy when fully powered. The efficiency of heat transfer depends on the material and how well it is insulated. For a small space, this could be sufficient to raise the temperature to a comfortable level.

Energy Usage: At full load, the heater will consume 40 watts per hour (Wh), or 0.04 kWh. If used for several hours, this can add up, so be mindful of energy consumption if using batteries or solar power.
